meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页和界面的显示效果，输出截图与结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常调整界面，想快速确认外观没有变坏。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect web, terminal, or paginated UI and get a screenshot-based verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you update UIs often and want to double-check appearances before sharing.

howto.what: 你改完界面后,Claude 会自己截图取证、跑脚本比对,再派两个只读评审并行复核,最后给出通过、需修改或不通过的判定。
howto.when: 当你构建或改动了网页、终端界面、分页文档这类有渲染输出的界面后,或你问某个页面、组件、TUI 看起来是否正常时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一次视觉 QA,截图对比参考稿并给出判定
say.note: 截图、跑脚本对比,再派两个评审出结论

say.text: 这张页面和我的 mock 逐页对比,看有没有偏差
say.note: 按整份清单逐页取证,不抽样

say.text: 检查这个 TUI 的边框和宽字符有没有溢出或错位
say.note: 生成真彩终端截图并跑宽度检查

howto.what_en: After you build or change a UI, Claude captures screenshots, runs script evidence, dispatches two read-only reviewers in parallel, and returns one good/bad verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or change any rendered surface — web pages, terminal TUIs, or paginated documents — or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on this page: screenshot it, diff against the mock, give a verdict
say_en.note: Captures, diffs, then dispatches two reviewers

say_en.text: Compare this page against my reference packet, page by page
say_en.note: Every enumerated page captured, not sampled

say_en.text: Check this TUI for border misalignment and wide-char overflow
say_en.note: Renders a true-color capture, runs the width check
